title: my_coachs_final_grade
display_title: My gym teacher gave me a zero on the one thing that meant everything to me
beats: My high school PE teacher gave me a zero on my final parkour project, and I never told anyone why I let him.
For six weeks I'd been building a course in the school gym after hours, timing every run, filming every attempt on my phone.
The final was simple: land one clean run, submitted on video, for 30% of my grade.
I landed it on my last try, 11:58 PM, hands shaking, personal best by four full seconds.
I went to export the clip and my phone said storage full, video not saved, footage gone.
I begged him for one more night to redo it. He said rules are rules and marked it a zero.
I let my final grade drop a full letter rather than admit the only proof I had was a memory no one else would ever see.
Send this to anyone who's ever had their proof disappear right when it mattered most.
Should I have fought harder, or was some things aren't worth arguing for?
